projects.name: Project Dorothy
projects.quote: We transitioned our flagship data center Project Dorothy from construction to operations.

projects.name: Project Dorothy 1A
projects.quote: The project is comprised of two elements, Project Dorothy 1A (“D1A”), and Project Dorothy 1B (“D1B”), each 25 MW facilities.

projects.name: Project Dorothy 1B
projects.quote: The project is comprised of two elements, Project Dorothy 1A (“D1A”), and Project Dorothy 1B (“D1B”), each 25 MW facilities.

projects.name: Project Sophie
projects.quote: Project Sophie is a 25 MW data center, based in Murray, Kentucky connected to the grid, (“Sophie”).

projects.name: Project Sophie Power Purchase Agreement
projects.quote: The project has a Power Purchase Agreement (“PPA”) that requires the curtailment of the site during certain hours of the day to help balance the Kentucky grid.

projects.name: Project Marie
projects.quote: In February 2023, Project Marie, our 20 MW data center in Kentucky was decommissioned.

projects.name: Project Edith
projects.quote: Project Edith was a project permitted to consume up to 3.3 MWs located in Wenatchee, Washington.

projects.name: Dorothy 2
projects.quote: In 2023, we began the planning process for building out the second 50 MW phase of Project Dorothy – Dorothy 2.

projects.name: Kati
projects.quote: We signed a term sheet for a new 166 MW data center called Kati that will be integrated with a 300 MW wind farm that has surplus energy due to increasing curtailment by the grid.
